title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (pp. 750–761 of the 'Longue Marche' sequel, section '1°) Action différentiable et groupes de Teichmüller spéciaux'):
- X is a connected, oriented, differentiable surface, compact in the case of interest.
- I ⊂ X is a discrete set of marked points.
- For each i ∈ I, S_i is the circle of tangent half-lines at i, S = ∐ S_i, and S̃ = ∐ S̃_i, where each S̃_i is a universal cover (a real line).
- T_0 is the orientation module of S (≅ Z, canonically π_1 of an oriented circle). It acts on each S̃_i as the deck group, so S̃/T_0 ≅ S (eq. 3).

On this page:
- For a diffeomorphism u of (X,I), the induced map u_S on tangent directions has lifts ũ to S̃. The set of lifts is a torsor under T_0^I acting on the left: one independent deck translation per marked point.
- For a topological group G acting differentiably on (X,I), hence continuously on S, he sets G̃ = {(u,ũ) : u ∈ G, ũ a continuous lift of u_S to S̃} (eq. 4).
- G̃ carries a canonical topology: convergence of u plus uniform convergence of ũ.
- With it, G̃ → G is a covering with group T_0^I, giving an extension 1 → T_0^I → G̃ → G → 1 (eq. 6).
- Margin NB: G acts on T_0^I by conjugation. This action goes through the orientation character, and also permutes the factors when G moves the points of I. So the extension is not central in general.
- The page begins a Proposition: 'suppose X compact'.

The next page completes it as a morphism of extensions from (6) to 1 → T_0^I → Sp T(X,S) → T(X,S) → 1. Here T(X,S) is the Teichmüller (mapping class) group and Sp T(X,S) is the 'special Teichmüller group'.

In modern terms:
- Taking G = Diff^+(X,I), Sp T is π_0 of G̃. This is the mapping class group of the real oriented blow-up of X at I, i.e. the surface with |I| boundary circles, Γ_g^{n}.
- The kernel Z^n is generated by the boundary Dehn twists. A full rotation of the lift on S̃_i corresponds to a twist about the i-th boundary circle.
- The construction is the topological counterpart of 'tangential base points': a lift ũ amounts to a choice of lifts ã_i of the images of chosen origins e_i, i.e. tangential base points with a continuous choice of 'logarithm of angle'.
- Purpose: to get the extended Teichmüller groups / tower with tangential data needed for the Galois action on Teichmüller groupoids (Longue Marche / Esquisse programme).
errors: Exactness of the bottom row 1 → T_0^I → Sp T → T → 1 on π_0 requires the hyperbolic (stable) case 2g−2+|I|>0. For example, for the sphere with one marked point the boundary twist is trivial in the mapping class group of the disc. This also uses contractibility of Diff_0 (Earle–Eells) to pass from G̃ to π_0. The page only says 'X compact'; any extra hypothesis may be in the omitted part of the proposition.
Transcribed line (5) is garbled. It should read that G̃ → G makes G̃ a covering of G with group T_0^I, not G a covering of G̃.

The extension (6) is not central in general (orientation reversal, permutation of I). The margin NB acknowledges this, but the bottom row in (7) must then be understood as a semi-direct-type, non-central extension when G is not orientation-preserving or does not fix I pointwise.

ideas.what: Extension of the Diff group (and mapping class group) of a marked surface by Z^I via lifts of the action on tangent-direction circles to their universal covers
ideas.modern_name: Mapping class group of the surface with boundary (real oriented blow-up) as extension of Γ_{g,n} by Z^n of boundary Dehn twists; framed/tangential base points
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Birman exact sequences, boundary twist central extension); tangential base points: Deligne 1989, Ihara, Nakamura
ideas.where_published: Possibly in the 1981 'La Longue Marche' / Esquisse d'un programme discussions of Teichmüller groupoids with tangential base points; the term 'groupe de Teichmüller spécial' is not attested in published texts to my knowledge

ideas.what: Canonical topology on G̃ making G̃ → G a covering, giving an extension of topological groups and a morphism to the π_0-level extension
ideas.modern_name: Covering group of a transformation group induced by lifting to universal cover of a boundary circle

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but standard construction: Z^I-extension of the mapping class group via tangential lifts, i.e. the mapping class group with boundary or tangential base points. It is well known in the Grothendieck–Teichmüller literature. The only mild interest is Grothendieck's own name 'groupe de Teichmüller spécial' and the explicit topologized Diff-level construction.
transcription_corrections: '(ici [?] un cas comme dessus)' likely reads '(et si on est dans un cas comme dessus)' or similar; 'opère à g.' = 'opère à gauche'.
Line (5): should be 'Alors G̃ → G fasse de G̃ un revêtement de G, de groupe T_0^I', not 'G ↪ G̃ ... revêtement de G̃'.
'opère en fait sur 𝒮' is probably 'opère en fait sur S̃', the universal cover, with quotient S̃/T_0 ≃ S.
'donc [défo] opération continue' is likely 'd'où une opération continue sur S'.
Margin note: 'NB G opère sur T_0^I via le caractère d'orientation' (and permutation of I).
